subject: Azure Partner Center referral weave: proposed mapping & seller ownership
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@contoso.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marketplace.ops@azure.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Partner Center referrals -> field ownership (Contoso roster attached)

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're on a tight timeline to finalize our Azure marketplace listing and need to lock the Partner Center referral ownership mapping so Azure referrals route to the correct Contoso & Redwood sellers. Azure is asking for a Partner Center owner mapping before the listing goes live.

Attached is our current account roster (CSV). There are three classes: Enterprise, Strategic, Commercial. Ideally:
- Enterprise -> Contoso field SE + Redwood AE
- Strategic -> Contoso AE + Redwood channel rep
- Commercial -> playbook-handled (no dedicated owner)

Can your team propose a mapping approach that:
1) Accepts Partner Center referral (PCE ID) -> maps to an owner list (primary + fallback)
2) Honors co-sell-enabled accounts flagged in our roster
3) Integrates with HubSpot deal assignment (we'll share HubSpot IDs)

We'd like a 30-min mapping workshop this week. Availability: Wed/Thu afternoons PST.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Khan
Partner Programs, Contoso

Hi Samir — thanks for the roster and the context. Looping in Vanessa and Karthik from our GTM team; they're the folks who run Partner Center routing for co-sell.

Suggested next steps from our side:
1) We drop a draft mapping spreadsheet that enumerates account, PCE flag, HubSpot ID, suggested primary owner, fallback (regional AE), and notes on co-sell eligibility.
2) Workshop (30m) to review the draft, confirm sticky accounts, and lock fallback rules.
3) We publish mapping into Partner Center and run a small referral test with 4 accounts.

I've attached our draft template (2026-06-PC-mapping-draft.xlsx). Can you confirm HubSpot deal IDs for the accounts marked as co-sell? Also please flag any accounts that must not be routed to Contoso sellers for legal/regulatory reasons.

Proposed workshop times: Wed 6/17 2:00–2:30pm PST or Thu 6/18 3:00–3:30pm PST. Which works?

—Olga

Thanks — quick clarifying note from the Partner Center side before the workshop:

- Partner Center requires one `primary` partner contact, but we can configure routing rules to split by account tier. We'll propose a primary + fallback column in the draft.
- For co-sell-enabled accounts, Azure checks the co-sell eligibility flag. If set, referrals route to the co-sell owner. If not, we fallback to the partner owner you nominate.

I'll pre-populate the draft with two example accounts (one Enterprise, one Commercial) so the workshop can validate logic instead of starting from blank.

Drive doc for mapping logic (editable): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c_partner-mapping

Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz | Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
